transient: the issue file cannot be read for a moment (an OS error other than a missing file); retried in code, 3 attempts
permanent: the issue number does not exist
issue_number is not a positive integer, or is a string such as "issue-4192"

transient: the index, or with source disk a file, cannot be read for a moment; retried in code, 3 attempts
permanent: the query is empty or only whitespace
the query is longer than 200 characters
path_glob is not a valid glob
max_results is outside 1 to 20
source or response_format is not one of its values

transient: the file cannot be read for a moment (an OS error other than a missing file); retried in code, 3 attempts
permanent: no such file, case included (near matches are named)
the path is outside the repository
the path is under config/
the file is not text
the path is empty or longer than 300 characters

transient: the tracker timed out before the write reached it (timeout_before_commit); the caller cannot tell this from the ambiguous case, so it is handled as ambiguous
the read that checks for the comment is unavailable for a moment
permanent: the issue does not exist
the body is empty
the body is longer than 4,000 characters
the body's first two lines are not label: and file:
ambiguous: the tracker timed out after the write was sent: the comment may have committed (timeout_after_commit)
under READBACK_FAIL, the read that would settle whether it landed fails too

transient: the tracker timed out before the write reached it (timeout_before_commit); handled as ambiguous, as for the comment
the read that checks for an open PR on the branch is unavailable for a moment
permanent: the issue does not exist
the branch is not repomind/issue-<issue_number>
the title is empty or longer than 120 characters
the body is empty or longer than 4,000 characters
ambiguous: the tracker timed out after the write was sent: the PR may have been opened (timeout_after_commit)
under READBACK_FAIL, the read that would settle whether it landed fails too
